message.text: I recall connect.ts has an authInterceptor, so I should check auth-state.ts to see how access and refresh tokens are stored, then look at the backend's authenticator.go to see how those tokens get validated.

The refresh token is probably stored server-side as an httpOnly cookie, given the refreshToken RPC uses credentials-include for cookie-based refresh. I should check auth_service_session.go on the backend to find the refresh token cookie name.
